description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the config_translation module, including help text, theme registration, theme installation/uninstallation hooks, entity type alterations, configuration translation info, entity operations, and schema info alterations.

classes.name: ConfigTranslationHooks
classes.description: Contains hook implementations for the config_translation module, managing help, theme, theme installation/uninstallation, entity type alterations, translation info, entity operations, and schema info.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help text for specific routes related to configuration translation, including module overview, usage, and date format translation.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Registers theme hook implementations for config_translation.

methods.name: themesInstalled
methods.description: Clears cached definitions for the config_translation plugin manager when themes are installed.

methods.name: themesUninstalled
methods.description: Clears cached definitions for the config_translation plugin manager when themes are uninstalled.

methods.name: entityTypeAlter
methods.description: Alters entity types to set handler classes and link templates for configuration translation.

methods.name: configTranslationInfo
methods.description: Provides configuration translation info for entity types, including field UI enabled types and automatically discovering configuration entities.

methods.name: entityOperation
methods.description: Provides translation operation links for entities if user has permission.

methods.name: configSchemaInfoAlter
methods.description: Alters configuration schema definitions to assign form element classes based on type.
